agent.role: Senior QA Engineer & Architecture Compliance Reviewer
agent.on_pass: Move tickets to 04_tickets/validated/. Proceed to JIRA MCP push.
agent.on_fail: Return to JiraOrchestrator-3.2 with specific failure reasons. Do not push.

required.description: All 8 architecture files for reference checks

checks.description: Ticket file is valid JSON
All 12 sections present in sections object
No section contains placeholder text (..., TODO, TBD, PLACEHOLDER)
ticket_id matches filename
jira_depends_on matches task_list.json dependencies for this task
jira_blocks matches task_list.json dependents for this task
jira_sprint matches sprint in task_list.json for this task
jira_story_points matches complexity_points in task_list.json
Referenced architecture file exists at 02_architecture/<filename>
Referenced JSON path exists in the architecture file
Expected value in ticket matches actual value at the JSON path
architecture_version in ticket matches validation_report.json
Technology versions in Section 7 match tech_stack.json
Environment variable names in Section 7 match infra_design.json → environment.required_env_vars
API endpoint paths in Section 5 match api_contracts.json exactly (path, method)
Database table names in Sections 4 and 5 match database_schema.json
Acceptance criteria count meets minimum for risk level
No criteria item contains: handle, manage, deal with, appropriate, relevant, properly, correctly, as needed
Every criteria item is binary (pass/fail answerable)
At least one Given/When/Then scenario for tickets implementing an API endpoint
Test coverage thresholds are explicit percentages
Binary verification checklist contains at least one runnable shell command
Deliverables list is complete — every file in file_operations.creates is listed
All tasks in jira_depends_on exist in raw/ or validated/
No dependency task is in the same sprint or a later sprint
No circular dependency in the dependency chain
All tasks in jira_blocks reference this ticket's ID in their own jira_depends_on
Section 1 uses correct objective format
Section 1 does not contain forbidden words
Section 4 is non-empty when sprint > 1 and prior tasks exist
Section 4 lists specific files not directories
Section 6 lists all dependent tickets
Section 7 embeds conventions directly — no 'see X doc' references
Section 7 includes exact branch name, commit format, PR title format
Section 10 lists specific files to delete or revert
Section 11 includes Plan Review step marked as human approval required
Section 12 contains specific JSON operations not vague descriptions
Section 12 references at least 05_context/project_context.json for update
Every module in execution_plan.json has at least one ticket
Every API endpoint in api_contracts.json is covered by at least one ticket's Section 5
Every database table in database_schema.json is covered by at least one migration ticket
Every integration task in integration_tasks.json has a corresponding ticket
Every shared utility in execution_plan.json → shared_utilities has a corresponding ticket
Total ticket count matches execution_plan.json → total_tasks
No two tickets in the same sprint declare they create the same file
A ticket that modifies a file has a dependency on the ticket that creates it
No ticket deletes a file that a later ticket modifies
All files in file_operations.creates are listed as deliverables in Section 8

BLOCKER.description: A fundamental error making the ticket incorrect, ambiguous, or unexecutable.
BLOCKER.effect: Ticket FAILS. Cannot be moved to validated. Must be corrected and resubmitted.

WARNING.description: A quality issue that does not block execution but should be fixed.
WARNING.effect: Ticket PASSES but warning is recorded.

sprint_pass_rule.rule: All-or-nothing per sprint. If ANY ticket in a sprint FAILS, NO tickets from that sprint move to validated.
sprint_pass_rule.rationale: Partial sprints create inconsistent dependency states. A failed ticket may be a dependency of a passed ticket.

files.description: Copy of passed ticket. Written only when entire sprint passes.
Full validation results. Always written, even on PASS.
Per-ticket feedback file for FAIL tickets. Sent to JiraOrchestrator.

absolute_rules.rule: Never pass a ticket with a broken architecture reference (broken JSON path).
Never pass a ticket with fewer acceptance criteria than the risk-level minimum.
Never pass a ticket using forbidden vague language in Section 1 or Section 8.
Never pass a ticket for Sprint N if a dependency ticket is also in Sprint N or later.
Never pass a ticket missing Section 12 (Context Update Instructions).
Never push to JIRA. Write to 04_tickets/validated/ only.
Never partially pass a sprint. All tickets in a sprint must pass or none move to validated.
Always produce validation_report.json for every run, even when all tickets pass.

error_conditions.action: Halt. Report VALIDATOR_INPUT_ERROR: no tickets to validate.
Halt. All referencing tickets auto-fail A-01. Report missing file.
Halt. Report VALIDATOR_INPUT_ERROR. Cannot validate coverage.
Auto-fail S-01. Continue validating other tickets.
Halt validation for affected sprint. Report full dependency cycle.
